chats.answer:
For keeping a reptile enclosure warm during a power outage, I recommend a LiFePO4 portable power station with at least 1,000Wh of battery capacity, especially if you want to run a heat lamp or ceramic heat emitter overnight.

The most important factor is how many watts your reptile's heating equipment uses, because heating devices drain batteries much faster than lights or electronics.

How long will a power station keep the heat on?

Assuming approximately 85% usable energy after inverter losses:

These are estimates assuming continuous operation. A thermostat that cycles the heater off can significantly extend runtime.

Two questions so I can recommend the right size:

What reptile do you have — ball python, bearded dragon, leopard gecko, snake, or something else?

What heating equipment are you running, and how many watts? For example, one 100W ceramic heat emitter or two 150W heat lamps.

With those details, I can help size a power station for an overnight or 24-hour outage without overspending.
